correctness.rationale: For each odd \(n\ge5\) the full cover nerve is a cone on the step-two cycle and the root-associated part is a cone over that cycle, giving \(S^2\). Deleting z leaves the contractible first part; deleting x_i preserves its cone nerve and changes the intersection to a path; deleting y_i removes one and only one nerve triangle, with the base cycle inclusion a natural homotopy equivalence. Mapping cones and the integral equivariant Mayer–Vietoris map give the vertex-essential support theorem and \(D_n\) sign character. The general argument is symbolic; finite checks validate representative combinatorics without replacing proof.
